sentences.show: He was the first Arab leader to make peace with Israel. It cost him his life.
On this day in 1981, Anwar Sadat was killed at a military parade in Cairo.
In 1973, he had launched a surprise attack across the Suez Canal.
Egyptians called him the Hero of the Crossing.
Then he flew to Jerusalem, the first Arab leader to visit officially.
In 1979, he signed a peace treaty with Israel's Menachem Begin.
Egypt got the Sinai back. Both men won the Nobel Peace Prize.
But much of the Arab world called it betrayal. Egypt was suspended from the Arab League.
Militants recruited officers inside his own army.
At the parade, as jets flew overhead, a truck stopped in front of his stand.
Sadat stood to salute. His nephew said he thought the men were part of the show.
Sadat and ten others were killed.
His grave reads: the hero of war and peace.
